test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some apartments are bungalows.

Some bungalows are flats.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some apartments are flats.

II. Some flats are bungalows.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements:

Some apartments are bungalows.

Some bungalows are flats.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309423ee173dec70034340968f9a70118654c2f77cef1bf043017eb0b2e4af39.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some apartments are flats. → **Not follow** (There is no definite relation between apartments and flats so it can be possible but not definitely true)

II. Some flats are bungalows. → **Follow** (Because some bungalows are flats, so some flats are bungalows is definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
